name: fixit-student-path
description: Standalone local classroom Python practice app with curated Y1/Y2 learning paths, anonymous summaries, browser smoke tests, PWA/offline shell hardening, configurable Pyodide runtime base URL, and documented optional local vendor Pyodide deployment.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-fixit-content.mjs && node --check app.js && node --check storage.js && node --check py-worker.js && find src -maxdepth 1 -name "*.js" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && npm run pwa:check
scripts.ci: npm run validate && npm run audit && npm run smoke:modules && npm run smoke:browser && npm run smoke:local-pyodide && npm run release:check
